charts.title: Revenue of the digital fitness & well-being device market worldwide from 2019 to 2028, by segment (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Digital fitness & well-being device market revenue worldwide 2019-2028, by segment
charts.description: Over the last two observations, the revenue is forecast to significantly increase in all segments. This reflects the overall trend throughout the entire forecast period from 2019 to 2028. It is estimated that the indicator is continuously rising in all segments. In this regard, the Smartwatches segment achieves the highest value of 62.46 billion U.S. dollars in 2028.

charts.title: Revenue of the fitness/activity tracking wristwear market worldwide from 2019 to 2028 (in billion U.S. dollars)
charts.short: Revenue of the fitness/activity tracking wristwear industry worldwide 2019-2028
charts.description: The global revenue in the 'Smart bands' segment of the digital health market was forecast to continuously increase between 2023 and 2028 by in total 16.3 billion U.S. dollars (+83.5 percent). After the ninth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 35.84 billion U.S. dollars and therefore a new peak in 2028. Notably, the revenue of the 'Smart bands' segment of the digital health market was continuously increasing over the past years.

charts.short: Total wearable device unit shipments worldwide 2014-2028

charts.title: Smart wearable shipments forecast worldwide from 2016 to 2026 (in millions)
charts.short: Unit shipment forecast of smart wristwear worldwide 2016-2026
charts.description: Smartwatch shipments worldwide are forecast to grow in the following years, increasing from 37 million units in 2016 to over 402 million units by 2027. Smartwatches are a major segment of the global wearables industry, contributing significantly to the global unit shipments of wearable devices.

charts.title: Revenue growth of the smartwatches market worldwide from 2019 to 2028
charts.short: Revenue growth of smartwatches worldwide 2019-2028

charts.title: Wearables unit shipments worldwide from 2014 to 2022 (in millions), by vendor
charts.short: Wearables unit shipments worldwide 2014-2022, by vendor
charts.description: In 2022, Apple was the leading wearable device vendors, with around 146.3 million global units shipped. Apple was followed by Samsung and Xiaomi, which shipped around 43.1 million and 34.7 shipments worldwide, respectively.

charts.title: Wearables unit shipments worldwide by vendor from 1st quarter 2014 to 3rd quarter 2023 (in millions)
charts.short: Quarterly wearables shipments worldwide 2014-2023, by vendor
charts.description: Apple is the leading vendor in terms of worldwide wearables unit shipments, with a total unit shipment of almost 30 million units in the third quarter of 2023.

charts.title: Market share of wearables unit shipments worldwide from 2014 to 2022, by vendor
charts.short: Wearables shipments worldwide market share 2014-2022, by vendor
charts.description: The wearable device industry is dominated by Apple, Xiaomi, Samsung, and Huawei. In 2022, Apple was the leading wearables vendor, occupying 29.7 percent of the market. Prior to Apple becoming the leading wearable devices vendor in 2017, Fitbit was the market leader with market shares close to 40 percent.

charts.title: Market share of wearables unit shipments worldwide from 1st quarter 2014 to 3rd quarter 2023, by vendor
charts.short: Wearables shipments worldwide market share 2014-2023, by vendor
charts.description: Apple is establishing a solid hold on wearable device unit shipments with 20.2 percent in the third quarter of 2023, dominating the market.

charts.title: Smartwatch market share worldwide from 2020 to 2022, by vendor
charts.short: Global smartwatch market share 2020-2022, by vendor
charts.description: In 2022, Apple led the global smart watch market, holding around 30 percent of the market. This value was slightly lower than the brand's share in 2021 (32.6 percent). Apple was followed by Samsung (10.1 percent), Huawei (6.9 percent), and Noise (5.8 percent).

charts.title: Quarterly smartwatch unit shipment share worldwide from 2018 to 2023, by vendor
charts.short: Smartwatch unit shipment share worldwide 2018-2023, by vendor
charts.description: Apple is the leading company in the smartwatch industry in terms of shipment share, accounting for 31 percent of worldwide shipments as of the fourth quarter of 2023. This was followed by Huawei with nine percent of the market share.

charts.title: Number of users of smartwatches worldwide from 2019 to 2028 (in millions)
charts.short: Number of users of smartwatches worldwide 2019-2028
charts.description: The global number of users in the 'Smartwatches' segment of the digital health market was forecast to continuously increase between 2023 and 2028 by in total 11.4 million users (+5.2 percent). After the ninth consecutive increasing year, the indicator is estimated to reach 230.85 million users and therefore a new peak in 2028. Notably, the number of users of the 'Smartwatches' segment of the digital health market was continuously increasing over the past years.

charts.title: Penetration rate of the smartwatches market worldwide from 2019 to 2028
charts.short: Penetration rate of smartwatches worldwide 2019-2028
charts.description: The global penetration rate in the 'Smartwatches' segment of the digital health market was forecast to increase between 2023 and 2028 by in total 0.02 percentage points. This overall increase does not happen continuously, notably not in 2027 and 2028. The indicator is estimated to amount to 2.88 percent in 2028. Notably, the penetration rate of the 'Smartwatches' segment of the digital health market was continuously increasing over the past years.
